name: J.I.T.
tagline: Scan a textbook's barcode and talk to a 3D avatar on top of it that answers from that book.

awards: MLH: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas

problem: Textbooks are static and intimidating for many students.
solution: An AR iOS app spawns an avatar on the scanned book; voice conversation is grounded with retrieval on that textbook's content.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan the ISBN, summon the avatar and ask about a chapter.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 307 submissions.
The frontend team learned Swift during the event.

lessons: A physical object that talks back is a memorable demo.
